== Notes ==
*Synergy with touch or attack skills causing knockdown, such as [[Hammer Bash]], [[Shock]] or [[Brawling Headbutt]].

==Trivia==
*This skill is probably a reference to the "handcuffs" bug in [[W:Street Fighter II|Street Fighter II]], as it can only be performed by Guile and prevents his opponent from moving or attacking.
*The [[skill icon]] appears to be [[Jora]] in her [[Brotherhood armor]].
